title: The two Reflection tokens created by Keeper of Masks sit in base as name='Reflection', might 0, def 'token-def-reflection' (trace base[] and boardById), and render as generic 'Reflection' placeholders / generic token art rather than as Keeper of Masks. Keeper itself shows might 1.
expected: Trace step 36 base[] shows two tokens with def 'token-def-reflection', name 'Reflection', might 0, while Keeper of Masks shows might 1. Source: create-token.ts:101-109 registers shared 'token-def-reflection' with literal tokenDef stats (Reflection, might 0); create-token.ts:142-150 registers the per-instance copy of the source card only under the instance tokenId. effect-context.ts:85-89 stamps the instance's definitionId as `token-def-<slug>`. snapshot.ts:366-368 resolves `def` via cardInstance.definitionId (the shared token-def-reflection), and lines 397-398 take might/name from that def — so the UI/snapshot shows vanilla 0-Might Reflection instead of a Keeper of Masks copy.

history.note: copy tokens record meta.copyOfCardId; snapshot reports the copied card's definitionId so Keeper copies render as Keeper

resolution.note: copy tokens record meta.copyOfCardId; snapshot reports the copied card's definitionId so Keeper copies render as Keeper
